stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.10 beta fixes two real custom Jobs.cz form issues found in v2.9.9 logs. The first-name selector no longer accidentally targets Czech surname input `prijmeno` or `příjmení` through broad `*jmeno` matching. For Siemens (ambiguous three text inputs) and VIG Re (assessment form with no safe positional fallback), if first_name alone remains missing, the app now offers up to 120 seconds for the user to fill it manually in Chromium; read-only validation requires a unique visible exact first-name value in a non-surname field, after which the existing human final-submit hold resumes. If not completed, the vacancy stays FORM_PARTIALLY_FILLED without falsely claiming submission and the agent continues to remaining candidates. Three prior submissions (Trigema, Adastra, mBank) confirmed. All 65 offline regression tests passed in GitHub Actions; no automatic final submit, employer handoff, or guessing input positions.
